figurative_meaning_en: Reduplicated word used to denote meaningless or unnecessary action, speech, or thought
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খালি খালি কথা বলে যাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: You're just scolding me for no reason.
note: This idiom exemplifies the common Bengali linguistic feature of reduplication for emphasis or to convey futility.
